points.place: 美国伊利诺伊州橡树园
points.title: 童年与成长
points.description: 海明威出生于美国芝加哥郊外的橡树园，在一个中产阶级家庭长大。父亲是医生，母亲是音乐教师，这种家庭背景塑造了他对自然和艺术的早期兴趣。少年时期，他热爱户外活动，尤其是钓鱼和打猎，这些经历后来成为他作品中的重要元素。高中时期，他担任校报《吊灯》的编辑，开始展现写作天赋。这段时期的生活经历为他后来的写作风格奠定了基础，特别是对简洁、直接表达的追求。
points.descriptionEn: Born in the Chicago suburb of Oak Park, Hemingway grew up in a middle-class family. His father was a doctor and his mother a music teacher, shaping his early interests in nature and art. As a youth, he developed a passion for outdoor activities like fishing and hunting, which later became important elements in his works. In high school, he served as editor of the school newspaper 'The Trapeze,' beginning to display his writing talent. This formative period laid the foundation for his later writing style, particularly his pursuit of simplicity and direct expression.

points.title: 战地救护员
points.description: 第一次世界大战期间，18岁的海明威以红十字会救护车司机的身份前往意大利前线。在米兰，他经历了战争的残酷现实，在一次炮火中腿部严重受伤。这段经历不仅给他留下了身体上的创伤，更深刻地影响了他对生命、死亡和勇气的理解。他在医院期间与护士艾格尼丝·冯·库洛斯基的恋情也以悲剧告终，这些战争经历和情感挫折成为他早期作品的重要主题，如《永别了，武器》的灵感来源。
points.descriptionEn: During World War I, 18-year-old Hemingway served as an ambulance driver for the Red Cross in the Italian front. In Milan, he witnessed the brutal reality of war and suffered severe leg injuries in an artillery attack. This experience left not only physical scars but profoundly influenced his understanding of life, death, and courage. His romance with nurse Agnes von Kurowsky ended in tragedy, and these war experiences and emotional setbacks became important themes in his early works, including the inspiration for 'A Farewell to Arms.'

points.title: 巴黎岁月
points.description: 1920年代，海明威作为《多伦多星报》驻欧记者移居巴黎，成为'迷惘的一代'的核心人物。在巴黎，他与格特鲁德·斯泰因、F·斯科特·菲茨杰拉德、埃兹拉·庞德等文学大师交往，形成了独特的写作风格。这段时期是他创作的黄金期，完成了《太阳照常升起》等代表作，确立了'冰山理论'的写作风格。巴黎的文学氛围和艺术环境极大地丰富了他的创作视野，使他从一个有潜力的青年作家成长为国际知名的文学大师。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1920s, Hemingway moved to Paris as a European correspondent for the Toronto Star, becoming a central figure of the 'Lost Generation.' In Paris, he mingled with literary giants like Gertrude Stein, F. Scott Fitzgerald, and Ezra Pound, developing his distinctive writing style. This period was his creative golden age, during which he completed masterpieces like 'The Sun Also Rises' and established his 'iceberg theory' of writing. Paris's literary atmosphere and artistic environment greatly enriched his creative perspective, transforming him from a promising young writer into an internationally renowned literary master.

points.place: 美国佛罗里达州基韦斯特
points.title: 海洋生活
points.description: 1928年，海明威移居佛罗里达州的基韦斯特，开始了他与海洋的深厚联系。在这里，他购置了一艘名为'皮拉尔'的渔船，经常进行深海捕鱼。这段时期，他创作了《永别了，武器》和《非洲的青山》等作品，同时培养了与古巴的密切关系。基韦斯特的生活为他提供了丰富的创作素材，尤其是关于勇气、坚韧和人与自然关系的主题。他在这座城市的渔村生活中找到了创作的宁静与灵感，同时也积极参与当地的社区活动，成为当地文化的重要组成部分。
points.descriptionEn: In 1928, Hemingway moved to Key West, Florida, beginning his deep connection with the sea. There, he purchased a fishing boat named 'Pilar' and frequently engaged in deep-sea fishing. During this period, he wrote works like 'A Farewell to Arms' and 'Green Hills of Africa,' while developing close ties with Cuba. Key West life provided rich material for his writing, particularly themes of courage, resilience, and the relationship between humans and nature. He found creative peace and inspiration in the island's fishing village life while actively participating in local community activities, becoming an important part of the local culture.

points.title: 古巴岁月
points.description: 1940年代至1950年代，海明威大部分时间居住在古巴哈瓦那郊外的芬卡维吉亚庄园。在这里，他完成了《丧钟为谁而鸣》等作品，并创作了代表作《老人与海》。古巴成为他创作和生活的中心，他热爱当地的斗牛文化、深海捕鱼和乡村生活。1954年，他在两次飞机失事中幸存，头部和内脏严重受伤，这些经历加深了他对生命脆弱性的思考。古巴时期是他创作生涯的巅峰，《老人与海》为他赢得了普利策奖和诺贝尔文学奖。1959年古巴革命后，他被迫离开，这段经历成为他晚年生活中的重大创伤。
points.descriptionEn: From the 1940s to 1950s, Hemingway mostly lived at Finca Vigía, his estate outside Havana, Cuba. Here, he completed works like 'For Whom the Bell Tolls' and wrote his masterpiece 'The Old Man and the Sea.' Cuba became the center of his creative and personal life, as he embraced local bullfighting culture, deep-sea fishing, and rural life. In 1954, he survived two plane crashes, suffering severe head and internal injuries, experiences that deepened his reflections on life's fragility. His Cuban period marked the peak of his career, with 'The Old Man and the Sea' earning him the Pulitzer Prize and Nobel Prize. After the 1959 Cuban Revolution, he was forced to leave, becoming a major trauma in his later life.

points.title: 晚年与离世
points.description: 1960年，海明威因健康问题移居爱达荷州的凯彻姆。晚年，他饱受多种疾病折磨，包括高血压、肝病和抑郁症，健康状况急剧恶化。多次电击治疗对他的记忆和创造力造成了严重损害。1961年7月2日，在海明威62岁生日前两周，他在家中用猎枪自杀，结束了自己传奇的一生。他的离世震惊了文学界，标志着一个时代的结束。凯彻姆的晚年生活虽然充满痛苦，但也是他反思一生、总结创作理念的重要时期，他的自杀被后人视为对尊严和自主权的最后坚持。
points.descriptionEn: In 1960, Hemingway moved to Ketchum, Idaho due to health issues. In his later years, he suffered from multiple ailments including hypertension, liver disease, and depression, with his health deteriorating rapidly. Multiple electroshock treatments severely damaged his memory and creativity. On July 2, 1961, two weeks before his 62nd birthday, he committed suicide at home with a shotgun, ending his legendary life. His death shocked the literary world, marking the end of an era. Though his final years in Ketchum were filled with suffering, they were also a period of reflection on his life and creative philosophy. His suicide was later seen by posterity as a final assertion of dignity and autonomy.

supporter.zh: 海明威被誉为20世纪最具影响力的作家之一，他的'冰山理论'写作风格彻底改变了现代文学叙事。他开创的简洁、有力的文风影响了无数后继作家。作为'迷惘的一代'的代表，他通过作品深刻探索了战争、爱情、勇气和生存等永恒主题。《老人与海》等作品展现了他对人类精神力量的坚定信念，即使在面对逆境和失败时，人类尊严和勇气依然闪耀。他的生活态度和创作精神激励着几代读者和作家，成为美国文学和世界文学的重要遗产。
supporter.en: Hemingway is regarded as one of the most influential writers of the 20th century, whose 'iceberg theory' of writing revolutionized modern narrative. His concise, powerful style influenced countless subsequent writers. As a representative of the 'Lost Generation,' he profoundly explored timeless themes like war, love, courage, and survival through his works. Masterpieces like 'The Old Man and the Sea' demonstrate his unwavering belief in human spiritual strength, showing how dignity and courage shine even in the face of adversity and defeat. His life attitude and creative spirit have inspired generations of readers and writers, becoming an important legacy of American and world literature.

critic.zh: 海明威的作品也面临诸多批评。他的'硬汉'形象被批评为过度简化了复杂的情感和人性，有时显得刻板和公式化。他的作品中的性别角色刻画常被视为过时和性别歧视，女性角色往往缺乏深度和自主性。此外，他的个人生活充满争议，包括多次婚姻、对女性的不忠以及晚年精神健康问题。他的政治立场也受到质疑，从早期支持西班牙共和国到后来与麦卡锡主义的暧昧关系，显示其政治立场的摇摆性。批评者认为，他的神话化形象掩盖了其作品中的局限性和矛盾性。
critic.en: Hemingway's works have also faced significant criticism. His 'tough guy' persona is often criticized for oversimplifying complex emotions and human nature, sometimes appearing stereotyped and formulaic. His portrayals of gender roles are frequently seen as outdated and sexist, with female characters often lacking depth and autonomy. Additionally, his personal life was controversial, including multiple marriages, infidelity with women, and mental health issues in his later years. His political stances have also been questioned, from his early support of the Spanish Republic to his ambiguous relationship with McCarthyism, showing his political inconsistencies. Critics argue that his mythologized image obscures the limitations and contradictions in his work.

objective.zh: 在历史学和流行文化中，海明威被定义为美国现代主义文学的核心人物，其影响远超文学领域。他的写作风格和生活方式共同塑造了一个文化符号，代表着一种特定的美国理想主义和坚韧精神。他的作品被广泛翻译和研究，成为大学文学课程的核心内容。同时，他的个人传奇与创作交织，使他成为20世纪文化偶像。在流行文化中，'海明威式'成为描述简洁、直接表达方式的专有名词。他的复杂遗产包括文学创新、文化影响以及个人悲剧，共同构成了一个多层次的现代文化现象。
objective.en: In historical and popular culture contexts, Hemingway is defined as a central figure of American modernist literature, with influence extending far beyond literary circles. His writing style and lifestyle together shaped a cultural symbol representing a specific American idealism and resilience. His works have been widely translated and studied, becoming core content in university literature courses. Simultaneously, his personal legend intertwined with his creative work, making him a cultural icon of the 20th century. In popular culture, 'Hemingway-esque' has become a proper noun describing concise, direct expression. His complex legacy includes literary innovation, cultural impact, and personal tragedy, collectively forming a multi-layered modern cultural phenomenon.

self.zh: 世界属于坚韧不拔的人，属于从不放弃的人，属于敢于挑战的人。
self.en: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, some are strong at the broken places.

others.zh: 海明威是一位真正的艺术家，他的作品简洁而有力，每一个词都经过精心选择，每一个句子都充满力量。
others.en: Hemingway was a true artist, whose work was both simple and powerful, with every word carefully chosen and every sentence filled with strength.
